messages:
kai (partnerships): heads-up 1: partner export for marketplace shows split-day buckets (00:00-12:00, 12:00-24:00) while our entitlement logic assumes full-day totals per customer. result: some customers missing daily entitlement top-ups. can eng check? :thinking:

andre (partner-cloud): we switched to 12h buckets to reduce payload size for low-connectivity sites. sample export: 

```
2025-01-14T00:00:00Z,contract=partner-edge-7,sku=redwood.embedding.small,units=420,window=00-12
2025-01-14T12:00:00Z,contract=partner-edge-7,sku=redwood.embedding.small,units=380,window=12-24
```

andre (partner-cloud): we assumed you would aggregate same-day buckets. our onboarding doc probably doesn't call out partial-day windows explicitly. link: https://partners.redwood.com/edge/usage-spec

mia (eng-billing): our entitlement engine compares daily entitlement threshold against the single event for the day. because partner sent two events, one at 00:00 and another at 12:00, only the first event was evaluated and the second ignored by dedupe logic (partner_event_id = "partner-edge-20250114"). result: ~150 customers didn't receive expected quota bump.

harry (finance): monetary impact estimate: ~400 credits incorrectly held back; if converted to billing credits it's ~$2.4k. finance needs corrected CSV and partner confirmation to proceed with crediting.

kai (partnerships): action items please: can eng accept intra-day buckets and aggregate them before entitlement eval? also add validation to onboarding docs that export windows may be partial-day and require unique event ids per window.

mia (eng-billing): plan: 1) change dedupe rule to use partner_event_id + window_start to allow multiple same-day windows; 2) aggregate per-customer/day before entitlement calculation; 3) run backfill for Jan 13-15 to compute missed quota grants and emit reconciliation CSV; 4) add a schema validator that warns if partner_event_id is identical for multiple windows.

partners-bot: created ticket PART-5987 (partial-day-window-aggregation) assigned to mia (due: 2025-01-15).

andre (partner-cloud): we'll add unique window ids in the next export and share a signed note that 12h buckets are allowed. we'll also temporarily re-send Jan 13-15 merged totals if that speeds reconciliation.

kai (partnerships): timeline?

mia (eng-billing): hotfix aggregator today (4h), run staging backfill (8h), produce CSV for finance in 12h. will update PART-5987 with CSV and reconciliation deltas.

harry (finance): once CSV is in, finance will validate and then request partner sign-off for credits > $1k.

andre (partner-cloud): thanks all. sorry for the churn  we'll push corrected merged files now and follow up when they're uploaded. :white_check_mark:
